description: Reads out sixteen inputs at a place set by a voltage, fading between one input and the next, so it works as a switch, an addressable sequencer or a scanner

params.text: Sets how many of the inputs are read before it starts again at the first, 2 to 16

inputs.text: One of the sixteen inputs being read out; with nothing patched here, the channel of that number from the P jack of the output channel is read instead
Fills the inputs from one cable: channel Y of this jack stands in for input Y, for the first output channel, wherever that input is empty
Fills the inputs from one cable: channel Y of this jack stands in for input Y, for the second output channel, wherever that input is empty
Fills the inputs from one cable: channel Y of this jack stands in for input Y, for the third output channel, wherever that input is empty
Fills the inputs from one cable: channel Y of this jack stands in for input Y, for the fourth output channel, wherever that input is empty
Sets the place being read, 0.625V per input over 0-10V, fading between two inputs in between; each channel here reads its own place and sets the channel count of the outputs

outputs.text: The value read at that place, one per channel of the CV jack
Carries 10V on a channel whose read value differs from the sample before it, and 0V while it holds

notes: the place wraps round by the Len setting, so with Len at 2 the voltage at CV sweeps back and forth between the first two inputs four times over its 0-10V
only the first four output channels can be fed from the P jacks; a fifth channel and beyond reads the numbered inputs alone
the lamps show which input is being read and how the fade between two of them stands

inputs.20:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
